### Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://www.nomoreide.com/install.sh | sh   # macOS and Linux
npm install -g nomoreide                                # or through npm
cargo install nomoreide                                 # or from source
```

On a Mac, `nomoreide menubar` puts NoMoreIDE in the menu bar with the dashboard in its own window, and `nomoreide menubar --login on` starts it at login. Anywhere, `nomoreide web` serves the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:4317.
